description: VYBE MUSIC v4.1.4 — Liquid Glass Navigation Bar Restored with Smooth Tab Indicator Animation, Google-Themed Update Dialog with Build Code & Google Verified Badge, and Automated Direct OTA Updates.

changelog.title: Liquid Glass Navigation Bar & Tab Animation
items: Restored Liquid Glass Theme: Frosted liquid glass backdrop with subtle luminous translucency and specular border outline on the bottom floating navigation bar
Smooth Spring-Physics Tab Sliding Animation: Selection indicator pill dynamically stretches and glides between tabs with responsive spring motion
Automatic Preference Migration: Upgraded installations automatically activate the liquid glass experience

changelog.title: Google-Themed In-App Update Dialog
items: Authentic Google Aesthetic: Features the Google 'G' badge, Google Verified security pill, Google Blue pill buttons, and Google dark surface container
Build & Version Code Display: Prominently highlights Build 9 and Version 4.1.4 alongside formatted release notes
Direct OTA Update: Immediate notification prompt on home screen with one-tap install

changelog.title: Listen Together Beat Sync & Bass Boost
items: Same Time Exact Accuracy: Tightly tuned drift thresholds (120ms snap seek, 20ms micro-adjust) and 1s high-precision heartbeats ensure both phones play at the exact same millisecond with zero audible echo
Beat Sync Bass Boost: Hardware-accelerated low-frequency bass boost synchronized across connected phones for powerful, punchy party sound
Stream Sync & Host Control: Resolved guest audio track synchronization and defaulted room playback to Host Only Control

changelog.title: 2-Button & 3-Button Navigation Support
items: Navigation Mode Compatibility: Added dedicated protective backing behind Android 2-button and 3-button system navigation bars to eliminate visual clash
Ergonomic Floating Clearance: Elevated floating navigation bar to prevent accidental system button presses in 2-button and 3-button modes
Search Tab Indicator: Unified search into the liquid glass floating pill with smooth spring-physics sliding indicator
